note: Pre-registered hypotheses and their outcomes, transcribed from the dated pre-registration log (written before each result was read). 'Reference set' results are agreement with the consensus of two AI assistants, human spot-checked. H11-H18 on Austria were measured with the 384-token benchmark setting; H21-H22 under the serving context. H19-H20 were planned for a paused plan and never registered.
